welcomeBodyTips:
- [ ] Try checking me: other blocks re-type instantly; click any block to edit
- ⌘1–9 switch tabs; ⌃1–6 set headings; ⌘T new tab, ⌘R or double-click the dot to rename; ⌥⌘← / ⌥⌘→ previous / next; Enter splits blocks, arrows cross them
- ⌘F searches this tab, ⌘G finds next; ⌘⇧P toggles source mode
- ⌘B / ⌘I / ⌘K bold, italic, link; ⌘⇧E inline code
- ⌃1–6 set headings, ⌃0 body text; ⌘⇧8 / ⌘⇧7 / ⌘⇧9 bullet / ordered / task list
- ⌘⇧Q quote, ⌘⌥C code block; ⌘S save now, ⌘⇧C copy tab text
- ⌘⇧Space shows/hides the window globally by default (rebind in Settings → Shortcuts)
- Themes and saving live in Settings… ⌘,; tab names, order and colors in Settings → Tabs
- ⌥⌘T keeps the window on top; Esc hides it

timeGuideBody:
# Time & Reminders

Add a time to a paragraph, list item, quote, heading or task.

- Type `@` at the end of a line to open the time picker, or use the default shortcut ⌘⇧0.
- Choose a date and time, optionally add an alert, then click Done. Click the time chip to change or clear it.
- Focusing a timed entry keeps the same time chip and places the caret at the end. You can move around the chip and type on either side; click the chip to edit its time.

```markdown
Submit report @2026-06-01 10:00 ~1h Attach the budget
```

`@` sets the event time (a deadline for tasks); `~1h` means an alert one hour earlier. Remove `~1h` to keep the time without an alert. The time chip may sit anywhere in the entry. Alerts include the readable text before and after it, not other entries.

Alerts require Zakki to be running. Missed alerts are not replayed after restart, and completed tasks do not alert.
